messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — autoscaler failure detected in aws-sa-east1. Queue depth > 12k for GPU workers; scale-up requests returning quota errors. Samples: `ResourceQuotaExceeded` and `ThrottlingException`. Auto-escalating to on-call.
oncall_jess: I'm on it. Switching phone to DND for now, will coordinate here. Can someone grab recent autoscaler logs + cloud quota API status?
eng-ops-raj: grabbing logs now. Early look: cluster-autoscaler sent 42 scale requests over last 8m, GCP-style error surfaces in our AWS quota sync: `RequestDenied: You have exceeded your vGPU allocation` from the placement API.
runtime-sam: confirm which pools are affected — looks like `gpu-prod-sa-east1-pool-a` and `gpu-prod-sa-east1-preemptible`. Both returning 403-like quota denies during provisioning handshake.
infra-alejandro: AWS console shows no capacity available in the tenancy for `p4d` types in sa-east-1 for our account. There's also an account-level hard limit we hit yesterday; we never got the uplift. Opening a case now but likely >2h.
oncall_jess: customer impact? which routes are degraded?
support-olivia: support telemetry: ~8% of active requests are getting queued beyond our 15s latency SLO, mainly customers routed to sa-east1. One paying customer reported failures on streaming sessions (took 30s then 504). Triage message for SOC/CS is queued.
product-ina: flagging possible customer-impact call if we don't mitigate in 30m. Suggest a targeted failover to eu-west-1 for traffic from SA region. Need ops plan + rollback.
eng-ops-raj: plan suggestion: 1) Pause new scheduling to sa-east1 for low-priority tenants; 2) Reroute high-priority traffic to eu-west-1 via routing policy; 3) Spin up warm pools in us-east-1 as secondary fallback; 4) Notify customers.
runtime-sam: to pause placements, toggle the scheduler feature flag `region.allow_new_gpu_allocations["sa-east-1"] = false`. Command:```bash
# temporary block new gpu requests to sa-east-1
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"region":"sa-east-1","allow":false}' https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/placement/flags
```
eng-ops-raj: applying that now.
eng-ops-raj: applied. Confirmed new allocations in sa-east1 are returning 429 with message "region blocked by ops".
runtime-sam: updating routing policy to prefer eu-west-1 for any request with `geo:sa` header. Patch:```json
{
  "name": "geo-failover-sa",
  "priority": 10,
  "match": {"geo":"sa"},
  "routes": ["eu-west-1","us-east-1"],
  "timeout_ms": 200
}
```
infra-alejandro: Routing change staged, applying now.
infra-alejandro: routing change applied. Live checks show ~60% of new SA traffic shifted to eu-west-1.
support-olivia: drafting customer status update: "We're experiencing capacity constraints in South America region causing longer queues for some requests. We've rerouted traffic to other regions; you may see slightly higher latency. We're monitoring." Want me to send?
oncall_jess: yes — send the notice to impacted customer groups now. @support-olivia cc @product-ina for wording.
support-olivia: posted notice to status page and emailed top 10 impacted customers.
product-ina: good. Any downstream problems with eu-west-1 capacity?
eng-ops-raj: eu-west-1 has headroom for a short burst; we've enabled additional burstable pools but need to watch queue growth there. Also turned on prefix KV cache to reduce token load for long-running chats.
runtime-sam: set cache TTL bump for high-throughput tenants:```yaml
caching:
  enabled: true
  prefix_cache_ttl_seconds: 60
  kv_cache_size: 500MB
```
infra-alejandro: AWS case opened (case# 1234567890) requesting quota uplift; estimated response window unclear. Also spinning up reservations in us-east-1 (preemptible) to reduce pressure.
oncall_jess: any chance to use older, smaller GPU types as a stop-gap (e.g., g4dn) with quantized models?
eng-ops-raj: yes, we can fallback to `g4dn` family with a quantized LLM variant. Need a quick model variant rollout: `model: t2-small-quant` and a traffic weight policy. I can push canary to 5% now.
runtime-sam: pushing canary:```bash
redwoodctl rollout create --model t2-small-quant --from model-main --traffic 5% --region sa-east-1
```
eng-ops-raj: canary accepted, running. Early metrics: inference latency up ~40% on that variant but keeps sessions alive.
support-olivia: updating customers: added note about potential model fallbacks for degraded perf.
product-ina: good — keep me posted. If queue doesn't drop in 20m we escalate to status amber and prepare incident postmortem.
oncall_jess: agreed. Next steps: monitor queues, track quota case, keep customer comms updated, and if eu-west saturates, shift heavier tenants to us-east preemptible. Assigning action owners: quota case - infra-alejandro; routing + allocations - runtime-sam + eng-ops-raj; customer comms - support-olivia; incident lead - oncall_jess.
eng-ops-raj: noted. Starting continuous monitor dashboard.
incident-bot: Reminder: on-call handoff scheduled at +2h. If unresolved, escalate to SRE lead.
eng-ops-raj: quick paste of relevant log snippets:
```
E1208 14:01:02.345 autoscaler.go:482] scale-up attempt failed: error provisioning instance: RequestDenied: Exceeded vGPU limit for account
status code: 403, request id: 7f2a1b
```

infra-alejandro: AWS support replied: initial triage done, quota increase requires security review. No fast path.
noncall_jess: ack. That means long tail. We'll rely on mitigation routing + quantized fallbacks for now. Keep this thread updated every 5-10m.
runtime-sam: metrics 10m after routing change: queue depth dropped from 12k -> 3.2k, SLO breaches dropped from 8% -> 2%. Good progress.
support-olivia: customers acknowledging receipt, one reported improved behavior after reroute.
product-ina: thanks team. Please keep incident timeline notes in the doc: `/incident create aws-sa-east1-quotalock` and add actions.
eng-ops-raj: created incident doc and started timeline.
oncall_jess: I'm marking this as active mitigation. If no full resolution in 90m escalate to ops manager.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident thread updated, reminder to add postmortem tags and link the incident doc when complete.
